tool_input.description: Syntax-check game.html script and run built-in tests headlessly

tool_input.command: sed -n '/<script>/,/<\/script>/p' game.html | sed '1d;$d' > /tmp/ash_full.js && node --check /tmp/ash_full.js && echo "SYNTAX OK ($(wc -l < /tmp/ash_full.js) lines)"
tool_input.description: Extract inline script from game.html and syntax-check it with node
Extract script block from game.html to /tmp
Run headless verification of game.html logic and tests
Run headless verification of the game logic

claude.result:
Done — `game.html` is complete at 68 KB in the working directory, with no other files created (the empty `result.json`/`stderr.log` were already there from the harness).

**What was built** — a fully self-contained ASHFALL OUTPOST implementing all 13 requested systems:

- **Core loop**: single state object, mulberry32 PRNG with its state serialized in the save (no `Math.random` anywhere), seed editable in the header, fixed documented 8-step turn order.
- **Map**: seeded 8×8 grid (ash/rock/water/vent/ruins), 16 building types with terrain requirements and adjacency bonuses shown in every build tooltip.
- **Economy**: real chains (ash→soil→food in greenhouses consuming water; ore→metal at forges consuming power; metal→parts at workshops), per-resource storage caps with logged overflow — including spillage when a storm knocks a Storehouse below 50 hp.
- **Population/needs**: named colonists with one of 4 job skills (1–5, grows with use), fatigue, morale; shortages degrade morale visibly with warning logs before starvation/dehydration deaths; 0-morale colonists refuse work, then leave after 3 turns.
- **Research**: 10 nodes with prerequisites, scrip/parts costs, locked/available/done states; unlocks buildings and measurably changes yields and storm damage.
- **Events**: 13 weighted events with 10-turn cooldowns, 7 of them choice events with real tradeoffs; **trade**: periodic caravans with limited stock/demand and prices driven by base × drifting global factor × your stockpile; **storms**: scaling severity, mitigations, parts-plus-labor repairs.
- **Save/load** via textarea JSON with validation and clear errors; **win/lose** at turn 60 with a scored summary screen; tabbed UI with keyboard shortcuts, custom hover/tap tooltips explaining every modifier's source, usable at 360px.
- **Dev panel**: Run Tests (22 assertions over PRNG determinism, caps, prereqs, roster consistency, save/load hash round-trip, bad-input rejection, 30-turn benchmark determinism, etc.) and Run Benchmark (200-turn greedy-policy sim printing a state hash that is identical across runs from the same seed).

**Honest caveat on verification**: this session's permission mode blocked every attempt to execute the code (`node script.js`, `node -e`, `node --check`, and a subagent retry were all denied; only `node --version` was permitted). So I could not machine-run the test suite myself. Instead I did a full line-by-line review of the assembled file, which caught and fixed four real defects (a seed-dependent test assertion, missing cap enforcement after storm damage to storehouses, unvalidated colonist assignments in loaded saves, and a metal-starvation stall in the benchmark policy). To confirm end-to-end: open `game.html` in a browser, go to the **Dev** tab (key 6), and click **Run Tests** — it prints per-assertion pass/fail, and **Run Benchmark** twice should print the identical hash.
